name: Finale: Spring Breeze
summary: Power 10 wind magic damage to 1 character.
description: One target character takes Power 10 + Bardic Power wind-type magic damage (Critical Value 10); a successful Willpower check halves it.

name: Finale: Summer Vitality
description: One target character recovers Power 20 + Bardic Power HP (no critical). Each target can benefit only once per hour. Undead, Magitech and Construct characters are unaffected.

name: Finale: Autumn Harvest
description: One target character recovers Power 0 + Bardic Power MP (no critical). Each target can benefit only once per day. Undead, Magitech and Construct characters are unaffected.

description: One target character takes Power 10 + Bardic Power water/ice-type magic damage (Critical Value 10); a successful Willpower check halves it.
